reviews.title: Poor translation and overcharging
reviews.text: The translations were so bad it was useless and then the app continued to charge me even after cancelling.

reviews.title: Charged me after I canceled within the trial period.
reviews.text: Don’t try the trial unless you want to be charged.

reviews.title: greedy
reviews.text: i’d give it 0 stars if i could. awful design, super pushy with trying to get you to pay them. why even offer a free version if you’re just going to make it nearly impossible to use?
